status: frozen after the direct-per-ObsID Gaia gate failed and before any relative Chandra-to-Chandra cross-match, any astrometric transform application, any registered event-image inspection, or any temperature-map construction
purpose: Replace the falsified requirement that every short Chandra exposure independently contain three Gaia counterparts with a standard two-level astrometric chain: one Gaia-anchored observation per cluster and translation-only relative registration of every other observation to that anchor.

parent_failure.decisive_observation: PLCKG287 ObsID 18807 had only two initial Gaia coincidences inside the frozen 2-arcsec radius, so the direct three-Gaia-pair gate cannot pass without changing its source or radius rules.
parent_failure.claim_boundary: This is a data-registration design failure, not evidence for or against the thermal-stress gravity source.

reference_selection.rule: greatest cleaned exposure within each cluster, with lower ObsID breaking an exact tie
reference_selection.reference_Gaia_transform: reuse the content-addressed transform from the failed direct protocol; do not refit it

relative_matching.input_sources: the unchanged binsize-2 0.5-7 keV wavdetect catalogs with SRC_SIGNIFICANCE>=3 and NET_COUNTS>0
relative_matching.reference_sources: the selected source catalog of the cluster reference ObsID after applying only its frozen Gaia translation to the catalog WCS
relative_matching.failure_rule: Fail the cluster map if the Gaia anchor or any relative observation has fewer than three final pairs or exceeds the 0.5-arcsec RMS gate; do not widen the radius, lower source significance, or fit rotation/scale.

application.reference_observation: apply its already frozen Gaia translation
application.other_observations: apply only their frozen relative translation into the Gaia-anchored reference frame
application.files: update every aspect solution and copied clean science/blank-sky event WCS; set ASOLFILE to the corrected aspect list
application.derived_products: recreate images, exposure maps, FOVs, masks, and spectra after registration
